name: Lau ca duoi
summary: Lẩu cá đuối is the sit-down stingray pot. Vietnam Tourism’s essential guide puts baby bamboo shoots in it. The local-eating article uses a tamarind and pineapple broth, with morning glory and bean sprouts. Vietnam Airlines adds bún and prints 150,000–250,000 VND.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Tourism does not name a street. Vietnam Airlines names Trần Hưng Đạo, Trần Phú, and Hùng Vương.
texture: Vietnam Airlines calls the stingray soft and free of small bones. The local-eating article serves it with morning glory and bean sprouts. Vietnam Airlines also puts greens and bún on the table, and mentions the smell of bamboo shoots.
taste: The essential guide names stingray and baby bamboo shoots and does not describe the broth. The local-eating article balances sour, sweet, and savory with tamarind, pineapple, and herbs. Vietnam Airlines calls the broth sour-sweet and the stingray naturally sweet. All three stay.
howToEat: Eat from the pot at the table, with the greens.
Keep both broth accounts. One pot may taste of bamboo shoots. Another may taste of tamarind and pineapple.
Vietnam Airlines prints 150,000–250,000 VND. Vietnam Tourism printed no price.
where: Trần Hưng Đạo, Trần Phú, and Hùng Vương, the streets Vietnam Airlines names. A shop name is not published here. The hour is Check on arrival.
Vietnam Tourism does not name a street.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 150,000–250,000 VND. Vietnam Tourism printed no price.
